Controls
W/↑ throttle, S/↓ brake, AD/←→ steer. C camera: chase (+- zoom, [] height), cockpit ([] or wheel: eye height, +- or Shift+wheel: field of view), front wing ([] height). R reset, G pit gate, X replay, P pause, M mute. Gamepads work. Lift to rotate the car into the turn, then throttle holds the slide.
